argv:
(version 1)
(deny default)
(import "system.sb")
; our own MLX dev jobs: GPU + read repo/venv/model caches, write only the run dir; no network
(allow process-fork)
(allow process-exec (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/.venv") (subpath "<home>/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.12.9-macos-aarch64-none") (literal "/bin/sleep"))
(allow file-read-metadata)
(allow file-read*
  (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs") (subpath "<home>/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.12.9-macos-aarch64-none")
  (subpath "<home>/.cache/huggingface/hub") (subpath "<home>/.cache/m0_models")
  (subpath "/usr") (subpath "/System") (subpath "/Library/Apple") (subpath "/private/var/db/timezone")
  (literal "/dev/urandom") (literal "/dev/random") (literal "/dev/null"))
(deny file-read* (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/.git") (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/runs/tdrun/_private"))
(deny file-read* (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/.wt") (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/runs") (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/.claude"))
(allow file-read* (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/.wt/mlxrl-A") (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/.wt/mlxrl-A-stock") (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/runs/tdrun/mlx_py-20261102T030920-4747"))
(allow file-read* (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/.wt/mlxrl-SP"))
(deny file-read* (regex #"/\.devkey$") (regex #"/\.env($|\.)") (regex #"/\.modal\.toml$"))
(allow file-write* (subpath "<home>/Workspace/rl_envs/runs/tdrun/mlx_py-20261102T030920-4747") (literal "/dev/null"))
(allow sysctl-read)
(allow iokit-open
  (iokit-registry-entry-class "IOSurfaceRootUserClient")
  (iokit-registry-entry-class "RootDomainUserClient")
  (iokit-user-client-class "IOSurfaceSendRight")
  (iokit-user-client-class "AGXDeviceUserClient"))
(allow mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.MTLCompilerService") (global-name "com.apple.gpumemd.source"))
(allow ipc-posix-shm-read* ipc-posix-shm-write-data)
